correctness.rationale: Mobius inversion of the gcd(a,n)=1 indicator gives C_a(N)=sum_(d|a)mu(d)*floor(N/d). Inclusion--exclusion of the common pair gcd gives J_a(N)=sum_(d<=N,(d,a)=1)mu(d)*C_a(floor(N/d))^2. Independent arithmetic checks give C_6(10)=3, C_3(4)=3 and J_3(4)=5, J_5(6)=13, so finite inequalities 3/10<1/3, 5/9<6/pi^2, 13/36<96/(25*pi^2) strictly hold. A separate direct pair enumeration matched Mobius counts on 176 (a,N) parameter pairs. For fixed a, periodicity yields C_a(M)/M->phi(a)/a, and absolute domination by d^-2 allows interchange of Mobius sum and N->infinity, producing the stated Euler product. The limit is fixed-a, not uniformly simultaneous in a and N.

final_claim: The finite-uniform coprimality lower bounds in Propositions 2 and 3 and Corollary 2 of Lomonaco--Kauffman A Continuous Variable Shor Algorithm are false in the stated integer uniform-cutoff model. Exact Mobius formulas determine C_a(N) and J_a(N); explicit (a,N)=(6,10),(3,4),(5,6) violate them, while for fixed a, J_a(N)/N^2 tends to (phi(a)/a)^2*(6/pi^2)/prod_(p|a)(1-p^-2).
limitations: Applies only to finite uniform integer model; no quantum measurement, detector errors or complete algorithmic complexity theorem.
